INSERT INTO /* LGVATT60060.createExcelActualAttendance */ XXLGE_EXPORT_INFO (SESSION_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARACTER_SET_NAME , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3 )
SELECT #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , 'Employee No' AS "Employee No" , 'Attendance Code' AS "Attendance Code" , 'Code Count' AS "Code Count" FROM DUAL UNION ALL select #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , NULL AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , EMPLOYEE_NO , TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE , to_char(count(*)) as Code_count from tb_att_result_n where
TO_CHAR(TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') between TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fromDateActual},'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') and TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{toDateActual},'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') group by EMPLOYEE_NO, TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE
